readout_other: tail-cuff systolic blood pressure; cardiac ultrasound imaging; c-fos immunofluorescence; plasma ANGII, Aldo, Cor, ET-1, ANF; HE, Masson, Nissl and TUNEL staining
direction_notes: LIFU of VLPAG upregulated c-fos in VLPAG and CVLM and lowered SBP of SHRs from about 172 to 141 mmHg after one month, sustained at 146 mmHg at the end of the 2 months.
safety_notes: HE, Nissl and TUNEL staining of the targeted region showed no tissue damage or apoptotic cells after 2 months of stimulation.

exposures.label: LIFU to VLPAG, 20 min daily for 2 months

timing.protocol_description: PRF 250 Hz, 2 ms tone-burst duration, 200 ms sonication duration and 5 s inter stimulation interval; stimulation for 20 min each day for 2 months. The Sham group received the same stimulation focused on the motor cortex.
